column1: # Members of the `play` profile in addition to every member of `fixed` (decision G30, 2026-11-03: the port diverges from the original on
# purpose; `play` is the app default, `fixed` stays hangs and faults only, `original` stays every switch at 1 and the test oracle).
# Columns as re/port/defect_profiles.tsv: switch value decision_id reason. A switch listed here must not also be in defect_profiles.tsv.

column4: reason
sinScaled interpolates index 255 towards the dword after g_sinTable (never written, 0): it uses entry 255 itself, a flat last segment (model_defects #10)
the 10-entry shot power cache key leaves out the putt argument, so a putt can return a full-shot result: a putt bypasses the cache (model_defects #18)
the strict-scan flag is never cleared within a target search, so once set every later landing is scanned strict: it is cleared before each landing's test (model_defects #37)
the hazard cell passed to the golfer thoughts is y * 50 + x against the grids' x * 50 + y: it is passed in grid order (model_defects #38)
two missed-shot exits skip restoring the named golfer's skill mask: it is restored on those exits too (model_defects #39)
g_namedStoryIndex stored as the 50-byte story id 2k of the opening file k (its readers' unit), not the 0x64-byte slot number k
a theme .pro golfer's ten skill bytes and their sum go into its own pro record, not the next one
cash stored into the int16 month history and ledger entry is saturated to -32768..32767 instead of wrapping
opening the financial report no longer writes each drawn year's column sum into the saved ledger row
per-tile thought counters g_tileMoodUp / g_tileMoodDown saturate at 255 instead of wrapping to 0
the par re-derivation walks hole records 1..18 once each instead of one record 18 times
no free walker record: spawn nothing instead of writing over g_editQueueX
at most 32 ball screen points appended
corner level stops at 0 / 255 and the key-0x58 reset writes all 51 bytes
story cache text cut to the 0x100-byte field
name and third text cut to their stack slots
bulletin event id of 22 or more ignored
the title menu's exit is selected only inside its own 0x3a x 0x39 icon, not over the 0x140 x 0x50 nearest-point area around the icon's corner
the theme-pack screen draws no sixth column cell (the original draws one at a stack word it never writes: a yellow cell left of the list on the current theme's row)
Gary Golf follows the cursor tile only up to the 50 x 50 grid's edge (the cursor tile is clamped for his walk target) and no walker's step leaves the grid
a golfer's walking step is clamped to the 50 x 50 grid, so no golfer (Gary Golf included) walks past the edge of the land

every camera writer that follows a golfer, walker, ball or photo, or offsets from a hole or object, clamps the camera tile to 0..0x31 like the arrow-key and edge-pan cases, so the view centre stays on the map

the HUD panels (build palette, terrain toolbar, buildings, amenities, employee and golfer panels) draw a hovered control's tip after more than 3 frames on it (about 0.37 s) instead of more than 10 (about 1.0 s): the original's `cmp [g_ui_5aa554], 0xa` at 0x00433257 / 0x004338ff and the same compare in the five other panels

the Build palette's tool tip box ends under its content (description, then the horizontal meter 8 rows under the lower of the text's end and the vertical meter's base) instead of a fixed 0x70-row box at row 0x192 whose bottom and horizontal meter (row 0x1ea) the palette covers: showInfoCursorPanel 0x00433280 / 0x0043328a / 0x0043364e

worldToScreen's on-screen test (playSoundAt's RNG draw, the story advances of golfers on screen) covers the host's wide view (W = window width * 600 / height, the view block's word): the same share of the view as the original's 800 of its own, centred; the original tests 800 only

tileToScreen's x window (the tiles whose scenery buildSceneSprites queues) covers the wide view the same way, so the side columns get their trees and objects; the original queues only x -0x40 .. 0x35f

the title menu starts each pass with no item selected, not item 1 (Start New Game), until the cursor nears an item (ML+0x11a95..ML+0x11aad): no item is lit on the first frame and a click away from every item starts nothing

a labelled title-menu item is chosen only with the cursor over its lit button art's pixels (per row the hull of the opaque columns of the highlighted buttons' picture; P23C, was the art box) (showTitleScreen 0x0043d054..0x0043d129), not within distance 0xa0 of its text centre (ML+0x11aaf..ML+0x11ae1)
Esc on the world map acts as its Back button (hot 3: 0x00470634); the original never reads the key words there
Esc on the buy-land screen acts as Done (0x004592e7); the original never reads the key words there
Esc in the character editor acts as a press on Exit (case 19, 0x00439d8f..0x00439dba); the original never reads the key words there
Esc in the editor's look picker acts as its cancel (a right click: 0x0043857d)
Esc on a popup without key handling (flag4 0: Preferences, the tournament par list; 0x0046db31 skips the key block) acts as its close button (0x0046dcdf -> 0x0046dd86)
Esc in the skill point dialog acts as a click on OK (0x0045f644; the points-left popup when points remain)

a press the widescreen host marked as made where a moved HUD panel used to be (the course shows there; view block word +4) takes the frame's world path (0x0041e4b8) instead of the System menu / panel tests (0x0041e400..0x0041e4b2)

Ctrl+Z undoes the newest course edit step (the edits of one left press): every setGrids edit (0x0040a130) is journalled with the code / refund it overwrote, and the host's undo request (view block word +8) runs demolishObject (0x0040a4e0, the original's right-click undo: previous content back, price refunded) on the step's tiles, newest first, then restores each tile's earlier record; Ctrl+Y builds the newest undone step again through the terrain-tool click path (mainLoop ML+0x10907..ML+0x113b9, H2_Terrain) at the current price; a placed object (H2_Build, ML+0xfd9e..ML+0x106b9) is undone through clearObjectFootprint (0x0040e400, no popup) with exactly the charge its placement took back into the cash, the facilities row and the total dword, and redone through H2_Build at the current price

at the furthest zoom (g_zoomScale 1) the tile pass draws the type class 0xd trees too (the zoom gate 0x0041407a / 0x00414081 skips them there), queued while the sprite queue has room for the entries queued after the tile pass

zooming in goes one level past 4 to g_zoomScale 8 (key 0x7a and the radial zoom-in button double the zoom while it is below 8 instead of 4, 0x0041c932); the golfer shade, the object phrase label, Terrain::setZoomLevel, the terrain strip update and rebuildTileData take zoom 8 as described at g_defect_zoom_in_max4

a held build tool or selection keeps every g_zoomScale (P4_queueAndSelection stores 4 every frame while one is held, 0x00415bcb..0x00415be6 = ML+0x660b..ML+0x6626) and key 0x78 never drops it (it drops both tool words at 0x0041c91e / 0x0041c923 = ML+0xd35e / ML+0xd363); P11E for zoom 8, P13A for 1 and 2: their clicks and previews are linear in the zoom, the translucent tile box is drawn at (z, z, 4) and the translucent sprites take their offsets at the display scale there
the arrow keys (ML+0xe971..ML+0xea73) move the camera 2 tiles at g_zoomScale 8 instead of 4 (the screen distance 4 tiles cover at zoom 4); the edge scroll keeps 1 tile per frame

the golfer and ball labels choose g_font51b360 over g_fontRef_519fd8 by g_zoomScale > 4 (ML+0x71b7, ML+0x7518, ML+0x7aa8); at the zoom 8 of mainLoop.zoomInStopsAt4 = 0 they keep zoom 4's face g_fontRef_519fd8; P26D: drawWalkers' staff / player labels too (drawWalkers 0x004038f0+0x3e0..+0x3ef)

Cancel in the character editor (case 18, 0x00439d74..0x00439d8a: the type record copied back, then the release wait with the done word unset) also puts back the phrase lines, the golfer skill bytes, the player skills and the portrait slot counters, and leaves the editor without the preference writes of Exit

the first unmoved-camera frame after the terrain is initialised or repainted from scratch runs rebuildTileData over the whole map (rows and columns from 0) and draws one full render; the original syncs the Terrain tiles (types, heights, walls, paths) only after a course edit (rebuildHeightfield clears bit 1 of g_tileWallMask[0]), so its first placement changes river banks and ponds far from the placed object

drawPanelBackdrop's tip bar (drawMapLine, colour 0x80000000, the terrain view's line only, which a 2D screen never shows: U-1071) is also filled into the 2D target under the white tip text while the character editor is open, so the editor's tips (the original's kTips: Load / Save character, the body and look controls, Gender, Cancel, Exit) read over its light art; the in-game HUD tips, whose line shows, are unchanged

a right click on the course with a terrain tool held (Ph_0041ecbb, button word 2, ML+0xfbac = 0x0041f16c) drops the tool when the right-click undo has nothing to act on at that tile (blocked, a 0x8000 tile, or no placed object and g_tileBuildCode 0xff: demolishObject 0x0040a4e0 tests); on any other tile, and with no tool held, the original marks / undoes the tile (an object tool is dropped by the original itself, ML+0xfbe3 = 0x0041f1a3)

key 0x68 ('h') opens the hole being built also in panel mode 3, which updateGolfers sets while the player's golfer waits for its shot (updateGolfers+0x35c2), when openHole 0x0040e720 would open it (tee and green set, the second tee when g_flags bit 6 asks for it, par byte 0); the original there sets g_playerShotStyle = 3 (ML+0xd119..ML+0xd124 = 0x0041c6d9..0x0041c6e4) and the hole stays shut

a fairway / firm fairway tile (types 2 / 3) whose Terrain rotation (the exe's g_tileVariant, 12 + orientation % 12 for a painted tile, H2_Terrain ML+0x10fdd / ML+0x1108b = 0x0042059d / 0x0042064b; Tab adds 1 to the orientation, ML+0xd42a..ML+0xd438 = 0x0041c9ea..0x0041c9f8) has an odd orientation is drawn by Tile::render with the texture coordinates of the next view on every face (each fairway piece's border is the same on all four sides, so it stays in place): its mowing stripes turned 90 degrees; Terrain.dll reads the rotation only for the sand trap, the green and water

the Build palettes' Undo button (the bulldozer: clickSlotPanel slot 0x15, the terrain toolbar's and building palette's -3, the amenities' items 7 / 8, all showing the help string 0x004c7ec4) toggles the game's dormant bulldoze mode, bit 27 of g_flags, instead (a left click then runs demolishObject 0x0040a4e0 on the cursor tile, Ph_0041ecbb ML+0xf6fb = 0x0041ecbb; P6_ToolLabel draws its cursor and label, ML+0xa657..ML+0xa746); a right click on the course clears it too, and the tips name it Bulldoze

rootWin_onKey (an arrow's WM_KEYDOWN: a key with no character, onKey(0, vk)) also keeps the arrow (0x25..0x28) in the held-key word g_char83821c (written by rootWin_onChar for character keys, cleared by rootWin_onChar0 on every WM_KEYUP, read by no code of the exe); while it holds an arrow, a frame whose key code (setDirtyFlagA's take of gDirtyFlagA, ML+0xcb1d = 0x0041c0dd) is 0 takes that arrow, so the camera steps once per frame from the press to the release, from the first frame head 250 ms or more after the key-down (P22A: Command::t in view block word +32; a shorter tap is one step); the original steps on the press and then only once Windows' key repeat begins after its delay

the bulletin board keeps one pending photo (f_w_4e3db8: record id and x, y in g_scrollTextWin + 0x54) that every postEvent overwrites; openHole 0x0040e720 posts records 0 / 1 / 4 (on Easy the first dogleg right / dogleg left / par 5 hole, postEvent at 0x0040e906 / 0x0040e949 / 0x0040e98c) in one call, so only the last one's photo is saved and the earlier polaroids stay empty (Mariano's play-test 7 item 6); the capture also saves the same picture for every other record of the same date whose photo file is missing

mainLoop draws each segment of a hole's shot line (the previous point g_golfers+0x9ac4 / +0x9ac8 to the next probe point +0x9acc / +0x9ad0, drawMapLine ML+0x423e / ML+0x426f) also when worldToScreen (ML+0x41c4 = 0x00413784) or tileToScreen (ML+0x41f1 = 0x004137b1) finds an end off screen: the ends are projected with a margin past any screen and the line is clipped at the view's edge; the original leaves that segment out (je ML+0x4277 at ML+0x41ce / ML+0x41fb)

in updateGolfers' look-ahead before a shot (updateGolfers+0x3798..updateGolfers+0x397d = 0x0042c178..0x0042c35d) a golfer k of the same hole with older or equal arrival order, flag 0x400 and more strokes blocks the shot while tileDistance(k, tee) < 0x64 (0x0042c1ea..0x0042c21e); a k that already played and waits at the tee for a partner who has not (the partner-ahead flag of 0x004292b4..0x004292e5, target the tee 0x0042a0aa) no longer blocks by that test (its ball, target and line-of-fire tests stay); in Mariano's save (P20) the player's golfer waited at the hole 3 tee for its partner, the partner was held by the pair on the green, and the pair on the green by the player's golfer, for good in golf_clean.exe too (log/roadmap/P20/P20A_notes.md)

while the shot of the player golfer (g_playerGolfer 0x005a59f8) is handed to the player and not played (target x +0xcc = -1, 0x0042be88) that golfer and its partner on its hole keep arrival order 0 and 0 strokes, so the tee queue count of every later golfer of the hole (0x004299f8..0x00429a5e, L38) never returns to 0 and nobody tees up (0x0042af61..0x0042af75), and the near-tee test of the look-ahead (0x0042c1ea..0x0042c21e) holds shots on the tee while he holds one near it; the whole course waited 5 game months for him in golf_clean.exe (Mariano 23 May 2003 save, log/roadmap/P20/P20A_notes.md section 8); with the switch at 0, outside a championship or pro match (g_flags 0x4200000 clear, the condition of the original player-pair exception at 0x00429a24..0x00429a40), the two are not counted in the tee queue and not held against shots by the near-tee test; the ball, target and line-of-fire tests stay; Mariano chose this on 2026-11-10

with playerWaitBlocksCourse at 0 the groups behind tee up while the shot of the player golfer (g_playerGolfer 0x005a59f8) is handed to the player and not played (target x +0xcc = -1), but the look-ahead before every shot (0x0042c224..0x0042c35d) still holds a golfer while that golfer or its partner on the hole (older arrival order, flag 0x400, more strokes) has its ball within 0x25 of the golfer's target, stands within 0x25 of it, or stands in the line of fire (within 0xaaaaaaa of the aim, nearer the tee than the golfer is to its target): his partner at the cup waiting for his handed-over shot held the hole 2 tee queue of his Ocean's Edge 25 July 2004 save in golf_clean.exe and the port alike (log/roadmap/P23/P23B_notes.md section 5); with the switch at 0, outside a championship or pro match, the two hold nobody's shot by those three tests (the game has no ball to golfer collision); Mariano's choice 2026-11-10: "Play past my pair"

H1 key switch (mainLoop key dispatch ML+0xcfec = 0x0041c59e..0x0041c5b0, table byte ML+0x1235c): capital P (0x50, case ML+0xda60) toggles [g_flags] bit 4 (the pause label bit), lower-case p (0x70, case ML+0xd3c0) opens the Improvements palette (g_panelListMode 0, g_buildPanelSlot 1); with the game clearing caps lock a plain P press never paused; p and P now take the pause case and a / A (free in the table) open the Improvements palette (log/roadmap/P21/P21A_notes.md)

a frame draws its picture (updateTerrainRender at mainLoop+0xf13, the sprites) with the camera of its start and takes the input after it (the P6 / H1 pumps, setDirtyFlagA at mainLoop+0xcb1d = 0x0041c0dd), stepping the camera for an arrow at the key switch (mainLoop+0xe971..mainLoop+0xea73), so an arrow key-down that arrives during the frame wait shows in the picture of the frame after the next one; with the switch at 0 the live host takes an arrow key-down that is the first queued key message at the frame head (view block words +12 / +16, recorded writes), the frame runs rootWin_onKey(0, vk) and the same camera step before its picture (one game frame sooner on the screen), P19A's held arrow steps there too, and a frame that stepped takes no second arrow at H1

the golfer list (drawEmployeeViewPanel, panel mode 2) has four columns of four golfers: a column change that takes the name x past 0x2b7 drops that golfer and the rest of the column is drawn past the 800-wide root (only the first 6 columns of a hole badge at x 794 stay, over the panel's right border), and its arrows page by 0x10; with the switch at 0 the live host writes the columns that fit right of its left-anchored panel in the wide view, n = (W - 800) / 0x79 (view block word +0x40, recorded), the list takes 4 + n columns, hitEmployeeSlot435570 hits them and the next-page arrow at 0x304 + 0x79 n, the arrows page by 4 (4 + n), and the app draws the added columns as layers right of the panel with the panel's own art (log/roadmap/P22/P22D_notes.md)

drawQueuedSprite (0x00462be0) draws a golfer's name label (drawCenteredText at 0x00462ea5 and the two Widget_fillRect bars) right after that golfer's sprite inside renderSpriteQueue's walk (0x00463100, list order = depth order), so every later entry (a tree, a water spout, a cliff face) is drawn over the label; the labels of the walk are now drawn after its last entry, in queue order, each with its own name text (log/roadmap/P22/P22C_notes.md)

drawGolferActionPanel (0x004362f0) greys shot buttons 5..7 when the lie class (g_tileTypeAttrs +0x22) of typeAtPos(ball x +0xd4, golfer y +0x04) is above 0 (0x00436457..0x00436465, a mixed pair), while the Lie text of the same panel (mainLoop 0x0041b786..0x0041b794) names the tile typeAtPos(+0xd4, +0xd8) of the ball, so the buttons can be enabled on a rough lie (and greyed on grass); with the switch at 0 the buttons read the ball tile (+0xd4, +0xd8) like the Lie text

updateGolfers hands the shot to the player golfer (flag bit 9) only when the ball tile type is not 1 and the ball is at least 0x19 from the cup (updateGolfers+0x3419..updateGolfers+0x346b); a ball on any green tile gets the automatic shot towards the current hole (prepareShot x == -1, updateGolfers+0x35f7..updateGolfers+0x3610), also on another hole green; with the switch at 0 a ball on a green tile not 8-connected to the green of the current hole cup is handed to the player (shot panel: direction and shot type) like a ball off the green

generateRandomCourse draws the clubhouse spot in rows / columns 0xF..0x1F (0x004715b9..0x004715e9) and stamps the free feature of locations 2, 4, 9, 11, 14 at (row - 1, column + 4) (0x004716be), or (row - 1, column - 5) when tileBlocked(row, column + 5) (0x004716a9), before the border sweep and without a test against it, so a clubhouse column of 30 or 31 on a 50-acre course leaves the practice green (kind 6) partly past the edge (9 of 120 seeds under Unicorn); with the switch at 0 a spot that leaves a clubhouse or feature tile on a tile the sweep clears is replaced by the nearest spot of the same window that passes the original's test and fits, with no added draw (log/roadmap/P24/P24E_notes.md)

the golfer list (drawEmployeeViewPanel, panel mode 2) draws its scroll band (track, bar and page arrows) and its arrows page however many golfers it lists, and a click on the band under the list takes the golfer of the last row of that column (hitEmployeeSlot435570 clamps the row to 3) and a click on an empty slot takes golfer record 0 (the list's cleared entry) and centres the camera on it; the staff detail panel (drawEmployeeDetailPanel) scrolls on a click at its next arrow while that arrow is not drawn (8 employees or fewer); with the switch at 0 neither the band nor an empty slot takes a golfer, while every listed golfer is on the first page and the offset is 0 the arrows do nothing and the app draws the band empty (the art's own band colour and list edge over the track and arrows, no bar), and the detail panel's next arrow works only above 8 employees (log/roadmap/P26/P26E_notes.md)

the full-screen screens with a tick button end at the first click anywhere: showHistographScreen (kMouseDown test 0x00456a06), showFinancialReport (0x0044fabe), showBestScoresScreen and showPlayerCommentsReport (the same button word test after pumpMessages 0x00455ea1 / after 0x00454c13), showCourseReport and showEndOfYearScreen (their report loops), showHoleStatsScreen, showRoutingMapScreen (a click below the map, y 0x101..0x118), showMembershipRoster (a right click) and showBulletinBoard (any click); with the switch at 0 and a graphics backend attached only a click inside the tick button box (the OK / close Image, 0x2c x 0x2c; the routing map quit box 0x296..0x2e6 x 0x214..0x255; the board tick cell 36 at 0x2dc, 0x1ff, 0x35 x 0x34) ends the screen; a key still ends it (log/roadmap/P26/P26C_notes.md)
